cr_data.provenance: (Doris Bry, New York, NY); Fenton Fine Art, Fort Worth, Texas, 1977; (Doris Bry, New York, NY); Grete Meilman Fine Art, Ltd., New York, NY, 1988; (Hirschl & Adler Galleries, Inc., New York, NY); Private collection, West Coast, 1988; (Hirschl & Adler Galleries, Inc., New York, NY); (Guggenheim, Asher Associates, Inc., New York, NY) (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature [note of inscriptions 1, 2, and 3] . . . Red pear and purple fig, bluish–white background." Backing inscription 2 dates 1921? Backing inscription 4 dates 1919. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1923. Pictured in 1924 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 24. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A large, bright red apple sits upright on a white surface. In front of the apple, a dark purple fig rests on its side.
